title: Lazar as a limited hangout used for recruitment

tellings.quote: that Bob Lazar was kind of a limited hangout of a person
have about Bob Lazar is right, which is he was this limited hangout of a person sort of meant to reveal certain info, but meant to hold back the rest.

tellings.link_reason: The same theory that Bob Lazar was a limited hangout, told by the same host.

plain: Michels suggests that Bob Lazar, a man who said he worked on alien craft at S4, a site near the secret Nevada test base Area 51, was a "limited hangout": an intelligence term for someone allowed to reveal part of a secret so the rest stays hidden. The story, as titled, holds that he was also used for recruitment. Michels tells this himself on two 2025 episodes, without naming a source. In the second, he says only that Lazar was meant to reveal certain information and hold back the rest, and he does not mention recruitment.
